subject.title: fix(nostr): keep profile imports as cancellable drafts

question: Should the Control UI change Nostr profile import from immediate persistence to a reviewable draft that requires Save & Publish?
rationale: The patch fixes a real Cancel and stale-response race, but it also intentionally adds a user-visible step to an established persistence workflow; code correctness alone cannot decide that product contract.

options.title: Adopt review-first imports
options.body: Accept the draft workflow so imported relay values never persist until the user explicitly selects Save & Publish.

options.title: Preserve immediate persistence
options.body: Decline or redesign the patch so Import from Relays remains a one-step write operation with UI wording and cancellation behavior that accurately reflect persistence.

recommendation.title: Adopt review-first imports
recommendation.body: Accept the draft workflow so imported relay values never persist until the user explicitly selects Save & Publish.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the Nostr integration and has the strongest available history signal for confirming the intended channel workflow.
